title: Evening National Mall Walking Tour + Lincoln Undercroft Tickets
includes: Timed Tickets to the Lincoln Memorial Undercroft & Museum
Entrance to: WWII, MLK, Korean and Lincoln Memorials
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Explore the National Mall in a whole new light on this small-group evening walking tour. As the monuments glow against the night sky, experience the rich history behind iconic sites like the WWII Memorial, MLK Memorial, and the Lincoln Memorial, all narrated by knowledgeable local guides. This tour not only reveals the stories behind the monuments but also includes skip-the-line access to the newly opened Lincoln Memorial Undercroft and Museum, allowing you to delve deeper into America's past.

- Guided small-group tour lasting 2 hours
- See key memorials illuminated at night, offering a unique perspective
- Receive skip-the-line tickets to the Lincoln Memorial Undercroft and Museum
- Fully accessible route covering approximately 1 mile on flat terrain
